rules.title: San Francisco annual allowable rent increase for rent-controlled units (3/1/26–2/28/27)
rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Board annual allowable increase
rules.quote: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.summary: The annual allowable rent increase for rent-controlled units in San Francisco is 1.6% for the period from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.effective_date_evidence: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.exemption_note: Applies only to rent-controlled units as defined by San Francisco rent control ordinance
